title: Macular Function During Anti-VEGF Treatment
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the changes in macular function during anti-VEGF treatment for neovascular age-related macular degeneration.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Neovascular AMD in first or second eyes
* angiographic signs of active subfoveal or juxtafoveal choroidal neovascularization (CNV)
* BCVA ≥35 ETDRS letters

Exclusion Criteria:

* Spherical equivalent ≥ ± 6 D
* Previous treatments for CNV in the studied eye
